# logtail_errors_linear_integration (Resource)

This resource manages the settings of an existing Error tracking Linear integration: which errors it files as Linear issues, and with which properties. Connecting an integration needs authorization in the Better Stack UI, so this resource doesn't create one. It adopts the integration given by `integration_id`, applies the settings in your configuration and leaves every setting you don't configure as it is. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state: the integration stays connected with its current settings. You can also import an integration by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connect Linear in Error tracking › Integrations first, then adopt the integration by the ID
# from its Configure page. Settings left out stay as they are in Better Stack, and removing
# the resource leaves the integration connected.
resource "logtail_errors_linear_integration" "errors" {
  integration_id = 123456

  applications = [
    { application_id = logtail_errors_application.this.id, environments = ["production"] },
  ]
  tag_filter = [
    { tag = "region", values = ["eu"] },
  ]

  # File an issue for every new error, as urgent, and resolve the error with its issue.
  notifications {
    new_errors = true
  }
  linear_priority = "urgent"
  auto_resolve    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (Number) The ID of the existing Linear integration to manage, as in the URL of its Configure page in Error tracking › Integrations, or as listed by `GET /api/v1/linear-integrations`. Changing it adopts a different integration and leaves the previous one as it is.

### Optional

- `affected_users_threshold_count` (Number) How many affected users trigger the `affected_users_threshold` notification.
- `applications` (Set of Object) The Errors applications whose errors reach the integration, each as `{ application_id = …, environments = […] }` with `environments = []` for every environment. Set to `[]` to include every application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))
- `auto_reopen` (Boolean) Whether a resolved error that occurs again reopens its Linear issue.
- `auto_resolve` (Boolean) Whether completing the Linear issue resolves its error.
- `linear_assignee_id` (String) The ID of the Linear user new issues are assigned to. Set to `""` to leave issues unassigned.
- `linear_label_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the Linear labels added to new issues. Set to `[]` for none.
- `linear_priority` (String) The priority of new issues: `no_priority`, `urgent`, `high`, `medium` or `low`.
- `linear_project_id` (String) The ID of the Linear project new issues are added to. Set to `""` for none.
- `linear_resolved_status_id` (String) The ID of the Linear workflow state issues move to when their error is resolved.
- `linear_status_id` (String) The ID of the Linear workflow state new issues start in. Set to `""` for the team's default.
- `linear_team_id` (String) The ID of the Linear team issues are filed in. Changing it clears the statuses, project and labels of the previous team unless you set them too.
- `name` (String) The name of the integration in Better Stack.
- `notifications` (Block List, Max: 1) The "Notify me when" toggles. Toggles left out keep their current value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--notifications))
- `occurrence_threshold_count` (Number) How many occurrences per `occurrence_threshold_interval` trigger the `occurrence_threshold` notification.
- `occurrence_threshold_interval` (String) The interval of `occurrence_threshold_count`: `minute`, `hour`, `day` or `week`.
- `sync_comments` (Boolean) Whether comments are synced between the error and its Linear issue.
- `tag_filter` (List of Object) Only errors whose tags match every row reach the integration, each row as `{ tag = "region", values = ["eu"] }`. Set to `[]` to remove the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_filter))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the integration, the same as `integration_id`.
- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team the integration belongs to.
- `team_name` (String) The name of the team the integration belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Optional:

- `application_id` (Number)
- `environments` (List of String)


<a id="nestedblock--notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications`

Optional:

- `affected_users_threshold` (Boolean) Notify when an error affects more than `affected_users_threshold_count` users.
- `automatically_reopened` (Boolean) Notify when an error is automatically re-opened.
- `new_errors` (Boolean) Notify when a new error occurs.
- `occurrence_milestones` (Boolean) Notify when an error reaches an occurrence milestone (10, 100, 200, 500, …).
- `occurrence_threshold` (Boolean) Notify when an error occurs more than `occurrence_threshold_count` times per `occurrence_threshold_interval`.
- `spikes` (Boolean) Notify when the application has a spike in errors.

Optional:

- `tag` (String)
- `values` (List of String)
